text_block_list.text:
During training, Special Week got injured,
so I quickly took her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
Looks like I messed up...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I was so desperate to get stronger
that I must've lost sight of everything around me—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's my own carelessness, I'm sorry...
choice_data_list: For now, let's just focus on getting better!
Take today off and give it your all again next time!
Take today off, and you can give it your all again later!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It's my own carelessness, I'm sorry...
choice_data_list: For now, let's just focus on getting better!
Take today off and give it your all again next time!
Take today off, and you can give it your all again later!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
True, Mom always said it's important
not to rush at times like this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heal properly... and return to training
in perfect condition...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*... Ehehe.
I have to... do my best, though...

...So that she would be able to resume training,
I decided to have Special Week rest properly
for the day.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, you're right!
If I get better quickly, I can easily make up for lost time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll focus on resting for today!
See you tomorrow, Trainer!
The next day, Special Week's gait seemed a bit stiff, so I gave her another day of rest.
The words meant to cheer her up might have only made her feel more rushed instead.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To become the number one Umamusume in Japan,
a wall of this size can be broken with pure fighting spirit—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uwooo~...! Heal up quick~...!
I know my body can do it~!!

"...Perhaps it did the trick,
because by the next day, Special Week was back in high spirits
and ready to resume training immediately."
